_note: Reviewed support resources (United States). Verify every number with the team before each demo. kind: crisis = suicidal intent, self-harm or immediate danger; abuse = abuse disclosure; support = distress, isolation or worry about someone.

988.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
988.description: Call or text 988, any time, to talk with a trained crisis counselor.

crisis_text_line.name: Crisis Text Line
crisis_text_line.description: Text HOME to 741741 to connect with a trained crisis counselor.

emergency.name: Emergency Services
emergency.description: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 911.

domestic_violence.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
domestic_violence.description: Call 1-800-799-7233 or text START to 88788 for confidential support.

rainn.name: RAINN Sexual Assault Hotline
rainn.description: Call 1-800-656-4673 for confidential support from a trained staff member.

nami.name: NAMI HelpLine
nami.description: Call 1-800-950-6264 for information, resources and support (not a crisis line).
